# Wiktionary

> > A free multilingual dictionary providing comprehensive word definitions, etymologies, pronunciations (IPA), and grammatical information across languages including Latin, Russian, and English.

Wiktionary is a collaborative wiki-based dictionary that documents words, phrases, and linguistic forms from all languages. Each entry includes detailed grammatical information such as declensions, conjugations, pronunciation guides using the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA), and usage examples.

## Key Topics

- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Latin grammar and declension
- Classical Latin vs Ecclesiastical Latin
- Russian language pronunciation
- Verb conjugation patterns
- Noun inflection and plural forms
- Adjective declension
- Etymology and word origins
- Slang and colloquial terminology
- Idiomatic expressions and proverbs
- Genitive, dative, and other grammatical cases
- Alternative word forms
- Phonetic transcription

## Latin Grammar and Inflection

- [pluribus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pluribus): Latin adjective declension entry with Classical/Ecclesiastical forms
- [debere](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/debere): Latin verb conjugation entry showing inflection patterns
- [malorum](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/malorum): Latin genitive plural noun form entry

## Russian Language Entries

- [раз в году и палка стреляет](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/раз_в_году_и_палка_стреляет): Russian proverb entry with IPA pronunciation and idiomatic meaning
- [заткнись](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/заткнись): Russian imperative verb form with IPA pronunciation guide

## English Vocabulary

- [street credibility](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/street_credibility): English noun entry for slang term (alternative form of street cred)
